name: Iyengar Yoga Utrecht
reason: Too thin: two certified teachers (Marga Rotink, Karina van Lieshout) giving weekly general classes in Utrecht and Almere; the site has only a class timetable and one price list (term blocks, trial class, private sessions on the same page), with no trainings, workshops or retreats, so fewer than about 3 items with their own URLs. Site allows us (robots.txt open); emails are published.
